Flydubai Co-Pilot's Plane Crashing Attempt Investigated

An investigation is underway into a Flydubai flight, FZ1073, involving an Omani co-pilot. Reports indicate the co-pilot was inspired by the 9/11 attacks and intended to crash the plane into an Israeli airport. The co-pilot reportedly confessed to UAE investigators, stating, 'I could not let people die.' Details of the co-pilot's past are being examined as part of the probe.
